_comment: Synthetic Call #2 result for client report v3 layout verification. Type 9 / SX9, matching the reference implementation's client (Anders Wennerstrom). client_facing.* and coach_report.* carry NO authored report content: they are optional, and the v3 pages built so far are library-driven. client_words.leading_quotes is the ONE exception and is populated deliberately — sheet 6's "In Your Own Words" band is the only per-CLIENT zone on the Exploring sheets, so with it empty the band cannot be rendered or measured at all. The two quotes are transcribed from the ratified mockup docs/mockup/claude_The_Peacemaker_Page_LeadingType_A_v1.html (BAND 3, .cm-words), which prints them as one string joined by an ellipsis — the same ' … ' join P3 uses for its 1-2 quotes, which is why they are stored as two. They are the reference implementation's words for this client, NOT the output of a live Call #2. Only confirmed_type, alternate_candidate and dominant_instinct_hypothesis are strictly required by buildClientModel; the score vectors are included for the Quick Reference page in a later PR. Instinct values are the coach report's SX9 figures (SP 66 / SO 64 / SX 84) per design spec v3.0 section 4.3, which requires anything sourced from the mockup to be verified against the coach report.

leading_quotes: I project a calm presence and this helps others regulate and calm themselves as well. It can be a powerful antidote to fear, anxiety, and other emotions that disrupt connection
I overthink things at times, perhaps often. This slows me down and leads to indecision.
